chart.title: How worried are Americans about their work being automated?
chart.subtitle: Survey respondents were asked, "How worried, if at all, are you that your type of work could be automated within your lifetime?"
chart.note: Number of respondents ranges between n = 460  and n = 568 US working adults per survey wave.

Don't know.descriptionShort: Survey respondents were asked, "How worried, if it all, are you that your type of work could be automated within your lifetime?"
Don't know.descriptionKey:
- Respondents were asked, "How worried, if it all, are you that your type of work could be automated within your lifetime?".
- Possible responses were "Very worried", "Fairly worried", "Not very worried", "Not worried at all", and "Don't know".
Don't know.citationShort: YouGov (2026) – with minor processing by Our World in Data
